610:t_1:3.en: ~ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ~

610:t_1:4.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...You've done a great deal for us, Captain.」

610:t_1:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Likewise. It was a good opportunity to learn how $$ジオン$$ fights.」

610:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Though there probably won't be any more fighting between the Federation and $$ジオン$$...」

610:t_1:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'll support the princess and the others aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$. I'm counting on you to look after $$マリーダ$$.」

610:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is eager to handle that. Apparently, he's declared that he'll protect her himself.」

610:t_1:9.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「So that ensign has matured a little...」

610:t_1:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Though with a headstrong rich boy like him, I suspect he'll end up needing $$マリーダ$$ to look after him instead.」

610:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's have a drink when this is all over.」

610:t_1:14.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Agreed. I wish you luck in battle.」

610:t_1:15.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...You've done a great deal for us, Captain.」

610:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Likewise. It was a good opportunity to learn how $$ジオン$$ fights.」

610:t_1:17.en:
$$オットー$$
「Though there probably won't be any more fighting between the Federation and $$ジオン$$...」

610:t_1:18.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'll be assigned to support the princess and the others aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

610:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「Leave the decisive battle with the Empire to us.」

610:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's have a drink when this is all over.」

610:t_1:22.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Agreed. I wish you luck in battle.」

610:t_1:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...I'm off, then, $$オードリー$$.」

610:t_1:24.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In space, I will join Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ and the others in negotiating with $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s remaining forces.」

610:t_1:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「Either $$ハマーン$$ or I could stay behind, $$ミネバ$$.」

610:t_1:26.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Do not worry, $$シャア$$. The name of $$ジオン$$ may soon disappear, but until then, I will fulfill my duty as a descendant of the $$ザビ家$$.」

610:t_1:27.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジオン$$ and the $$ザビ家$$ will both disappear... And still humanity moves forward.」

610:t_1:28.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To make that possible, we must free this world from $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:29.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...My one and only wish... You will grant it, won't you, $$バナージ$$?」

610:t_1:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come back to you, no matter what... I promise, $$オードリー$$.」

610:t_1:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They're promising to reunite... It's such a moving scene...」

610:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's not enough. At that level, $$バナージ$$ may not survive the battles ahead...」

610:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「To raise his morale further, I must teach him about making a promise for their reunion...」

610:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Make up your mind! Are you romantic or just tactless?!」

610:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's been a while since I last got hit by $$千鳥$$'s paper fan.」

610:t_1:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I made it in my spare time between life support duties. I figured something like this might happen.」

610:t_1:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You're completely back to normal now, $$カナメ$$.」

610:t_1:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Pretty much. Though all that precious $$ウィスパード$$ knowledge is gone.」

610:t_1:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What happened to your knowledge, $$テッサ$$?」

610:t_1:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We probably won't hear any new Black Technology whispered to us, but I have knowledge dating back to my childhood.」

610:t_1:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So I think I can still work as an engineer to some extent by applying it.」

610:t_1:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Being a captain and an engineer... Your busy days aren't over yet, $$テッサ$$.」

610:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't manage both, so while you're carrying out operations in the atmosphere, I'll help defend the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

610:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There's something I'd like to investigate using its facilities too.」

610:t_1:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then we'll be saying goodbye... for a little while.」

610:t_1:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You and $$相良$$ will promise we'll meet again too, won't you, $$カナメ$$?」

610:t_1:48.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll definitely see each other again, $$テッサ$$.」

610:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
(While everyone is liberating Earth, I'll analyze the ideas $$カナメ$$ came up with during her captivity and what $$レナード$$ left behind...)

610:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That power, and the data $$ノリコ$$ provided... They'll become the strength to open humanity's future...)

610:t_1:55.en: ~ $$セントラル・ベース$$, Command Room ~

610:t_1:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...So this Earth has indeed been under $$サイデリアル$$'s control since it ventured into space.」

610:t_1:57.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It is hardly surprising. There are over twenty such planets in this galaxy alone.」

610:t_1:58.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But even under direct rule, isn't this the first time in history that $$サイデリアル$$'s control over evolution has been made public?」

610:t_1:59.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Indeed... That matter alone has always been kept secret from the species under our control.」

610:t_1:60.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And astonishingly, it seems the Earthlings' morale is rising even after hearing this truth.」

610:t_1:61.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... With the resistance and Federation forces rising up, cracks are starting to appear in our fronts across the globe.」

610:t_1:62.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Though I never expected even the $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the South American front to fall...」

610:t_1:63.en:
$$尸刻$$
「An advance driven by emotion... Surely that stems from ignorance of $$サイデリアル$$'s power.」

610:t_1:64.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm not sure that's true... At least they know we're the ones who conquered their planet in an instant.」

610:t_1:65.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Just as both 100 G and a million G are huge sums to a child, they must know $$サイデリアル$$ is a formidable enemy.」

610:t_1:66.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then why do they fight?」

610:t_1:67.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It must be something peculiar to Earthlings as a species.」

610:t_1:68.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I have felt that myself.」

610:t_1:69.en:
$$尸刻$$
「An indomitable spirit that never gives up... Faith in companions and friends... The will to move toward the future with hope...」

610:t_1:70.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Of course they'd attract attention, possessing qualities like those.」

610:t_1:71.en:
$$尸刻$$
「And at the center of it all is $c...」

610:t_1:72.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「In other words, defeating them will let us subjugate the Earthlings both militarily and mentally. It is simple and clear.」

610:t_1:73.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Whatever the case, this planet is certainly unusual. I wonder what will happen to it now...」

610:t_1:74.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Once the $$オリジン・ロー$$ extraction system is finished and spirit quanta collection is complete, they will likely be erased as a dangerous species.」

610:t_1:75.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「In short, they will suffer the same fate as planet $$ジェミナイ$$.」

610:t_1:76.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then warriors with potential... meaning $c, will be incorporated into $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:77.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Just as 《$$ハイアデス$$》 and 《$$鬼宿$$》 were.」

610:t_1:79.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Since we're here, please tell me how $$ハイアデス$$ really feels.」

610:t_1:80.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I simply race across thrilling battlefields alongside Lady $$エルーナ$$.」

610:t_1:81.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ provides those opportunities. That is all.」

610:t_1:82.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So for that, you have no objection even to the previous chief being killed?」

610:t_1:83.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...It was all Lady $$エルーナ$$'s decision.」

610:t_1:84.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Supreme Commander $$エルーナルーナ$$ is the previous chief's only daughter. If she approves, that's all there is to it.」

610:t_1:85.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「How do you feel about it, $$尸刻$$?」
